commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Doctor Doom, King of Latveria ({1}{U}{B}{R} 3/3 Human Noble Villain): (1) whenever we discard one or more land cards, each opponent loses 2 life, once per discard event (603.2c), so the deck counts separate events, not cards: Seismic Assault, Tectonic Reformation's cycling {R}, cycling lands (Canyon Slough, Fetid Pools, Xander's Lounge, and now Coastal Peak), Trade Routes, Psychic Frog, Desolate Lighthouse, Geier Reach, connives, wheels, Faithless Looting/Frantic Search, Big Score/Unexpected Windfall/Demand Answers costs, and now Lightning Axe's cost and Mox Diamond's replacement; (2) at the beginning of combat on our turn a target Villain gains menace and connives (701.50a: a land discarded gives no counter but drains 2). Land-discard payoffs stack on each event: Surly Badgersaur and Green Goblin, Nemesis (Treasure), Bone Miser ({B}{B}), Monument to Endurance (once-per-turn modes), Cool but Rude level 2 and now Glint-Horn Buccaneer (per card). Villain payoffs: Prowler, Baron Strucker, Iron Monger, Tombstone, Doom Reigns Supreme, Ultron, Kang, M.O.D.O.K., Leader, Doctor Doom, and now Red Ghost's Ape Villains. Recursion: Crucible of Worlds, Containment Construct, Moonstone, Currency Converter, Oscorp Industries' mayhem, Shadow of the Grave, Dakmor Salvage's dredge.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (registry ceiling 4, Optimized; Grok estimate 4). Game Changers: baseline 6 (Ancient Tomb, Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Jeska's Will, Vampiric Tutor); candidate 7 (+Mox Diamond). Commander Spellbook: 1 included combo in both (Surly Badgersaur + Tectonic Reformation + Dakmor Salvage, listed as infinite self-mill / near-infinite self-discard triggers); in this deck it is finite and bounded by library size (n iterations need 2n library cards; with Doom alone 40 life needs 20 iterations / 38 library cards; with Glint-Horn 14 / 26) and stops on graveyard exile. No infinite is claimed.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Every add serves Doom's own Oracle: a land-discard event (Lightning Axe, Mox Diamond, Coastal Peak), a per-card payoff on those events (Glint-Horn), a Villain fed by Doom's connive (Red Ghost) or protection that preserves Doom's self-target (Boots). Owner-removed classes (opponent-discard punishers such as Kefka and Syphon Mind; Dark Deal) were judged and not re-added. Distinctness: the closest other roster deck by nonbasic overlap is Loki (exports/grixis-archidekt/loki-the-deceiver.txt): the baseline shares 53 nonbasic names and the candidate also 53 (the cut Loki, the Deceiver and Talisman of Creativity are in the Loki deck, and so are the adds Red Ghost and Swiftfoot Boots). Disclosed honestly: this candidate does not reduce that overlap; the separation is commander-first: Doom's land-discard drain package (Seismic Assault, Tectonic Reformation, Dakmor Salvage, Badgersaur, Bone Miser, Monument, cycling lands, and now Lightning Axe, Mox Diamond, Coastal Peak, Glint-Horn) is not in the Loki list. Overlap with Deck #12 Davros (PR #660 candidate): 34 nonbasic names in the baseline, 32 in the candidate.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (99 rows, all 1x; Island, Mountain, Swamp one each).
Roles:
- 38 lands incl. Dakmor Salvage, Ancient Tomb, Villainous Hideout, Oscorp Industries (mayhem), Takenuma, Otawara, Desolate Lighthouse, Geier Reach Sanitarium, Training Center, Luxury Suite, Morphic Pool, Xander's Lounge, Canyon Slough, Fetid Pools, City of Brass, Mana Confluence, Exotic Orchard, Command Tower, four fetches incl. Fabled Passage, originals/shocks/check lands, Shipwreck Marsh (cut) and Haunted Ridge.
- Ramp (7 rocks): Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone (cut), Talismans of Creativity (cut), Dominance and Indulgence, The Soul Stone ({B}); the candidate adds Mox Diamond (6 rocks).
- Land-discard outlets: Seismic Assault, Tectonic Reformation, Trade Routes, Psychic Frog, Faithless Looting, Frantic Search, Big Score, Unexpected Windfall, Demand Answers, Wheel of Fortune, Windfall, Change of Fortune (cut), Containment Construct/Currency Converter loots, connive Villains.
- Payoffs: Surly Badgersaur, Green Goblin, Nemesis, Bone Miser, Monument to Endurance, Cool but Rude, Archfiend of Ifnir.
- Villains: Prowler, Baron Strucker, Iron Monger, Tombstone, Ultron, Kang, M.O.D.O.K., Leader, Doctor Doom, Norman Osborn, Green Goblin Revenant, Moonstone, Chameleon, Loki (cut); Doom Reigns Supreme, Glorious Purpose, Roaming Throne, Spark Double.
- Recursion: Crucible of Worlds, Shadow of the Grave, Reanimate, Containment Construct, Moonstone, Currency Converter.
- Interaction: Fierce Guardianship, Swan Song, Deflecting Swat, Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp, Lethal Scheme, Feed the Swarm (cut), Toxic Deluge, Vandalblast.
- Tutors/fuel: Demonic Tutor, Vampiric Tutor, Jeska's Will, Black Market Connections.
Overlaps: seven rocks incl. two colour-flexible ones; a sorcery-speed life-costing removal spell; a Villain whose attack copies miss the commander's combat trigger; no protection for the engine commander.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline: 38 lands; land colour sources (fetches counted by fetchable typed lands; Exotic Orchard colourless; Villainous Hideout counted only for Villain spells; Oscorp Industries U/B/R) red 20; average nonland MV 2.852; 22 creatures; 22 instants/sorceries. Candidate: 38 lands, red land sources 21; average nonland MV 2.787; 23 creatures; 21 instants/sorceries. Exact lands-only hypergeometric (mechanics test): P(4 lands covering U, B and R among 10 cards) 0.5550 -> 0.5570, 11 cards 0.6477 -> 0.6498; P(RRR for Seismic among 11 cards) 0.3895 -> 0.4248, 12 cards 0.4529 -> 0.4904. Rocks, Mox Diamond and Treasures are excluded from those numbers (conservative).
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Fierce Guardianship, Swan Song, Deflecting Swat. Removal: Lightning Axe (new), Lethal Scheme, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Vandalblast, Toxic Deluge, Otawara (Feed the Swarm cut). Protection: Swiftfoot Boots (new; hexproof keeps Doom's self-target). Graveyard hate: the Dakmor loop, Crucible, Shadow of the Grave, Oscorp mayhem and Reanimate depend on the graveyard; Seismic Assault, Tectonic Reformation, Trade Routes, Psychic Frog, cycling lands, Lightning Axe, Mox Diamond, Cool but Rude and Glint-Horn do not (static count in the mechanics test: 10 independent vs 3 dependent outlets). Weak points: fewer enchantment answers, lifegain, a thin counter suite.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING (absent from every Doom EDHREC page: general, upgraded, optimized); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {R} instant: as an additional cost discard a card or pay {5}; 5 damage to target creature.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Feed the Swarm ({1}{B} sorcery: destroy a creature or enchantment an opponent controls; we lose life equal to its mana value), the list's only cheap answer that also hits enchantments.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: The discard is an additional cost (CR 601.2h): discarding a land is a Doom land-discard event (2 to each opponent), a Badgersaur/Nemesis Treasure, Bone Miser {B}{B}, a Glint-Horn ping and a Monument mode, even if the spell is later countered. One mana, instant speed, and late it can pay {5} instead.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Card disadvantage when no spare land is in hand; 5 damage misses indestructible and big creatures; loses the enchantment mode (Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift and Otawara remain as enchantment answers).
material_candidates.reason: Removal whose cost is the commander's trigger; the alternative keeping instant-speed enchantment coverage (Withering Torment) is staged.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Doom general 2268/11386, upgraded 242/947, optimized 63/216; M6 Pass C #13 requested +Glint-Horn / -Green Goblin, Revenant test; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {1}{R}{R} 2/4 haste Minotaur Pirate: whenever you discard a card, 1 damage to each opponent; {1}{R}, discard a card: draw a card (only while attacking).
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Change of Fortune ({3}{R} sorcery: discard your hand, then draw a card for each card discarded this turn), a one-sided refill that Doom triggers once.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Doom triggers once per event (603.2c) but Buccaneer triggers per card: a 7-card wheel is 7 to each opponent, every Tectonic Reformation cycle, Seismic activation, connive and Lightning Axe cost is +1 each. In the finite Dakmor loop it lowers the lethal library requirement from 38 to 26 cards (mechanics test). Hasty attack loot is one more land-discard event on the turn it lands.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: RR pip competes with Seismic Assault's RRR (exact lands-only P(3+ lands, two of them red, among the top 9 cards) 0.5318 -> 0.5573); a 2/4 body is not a Villain (no Doom connive target, no Strucker/Tombstone discount); dies to most removal.
material_candidates.reason: The bounded Pass C grid has Buccaneer >= Magmakin Artillerist in all 20 cells and > Green Goblin, Revenant on damage in 20/20; it takes Change of Fortune's slot rather than Revenant's (Revenant becomes the one-sided refill). Pass C's exact pairing is staged.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Doom general 5877/10768, upgraded 394/914, optimized 48/209; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {2}{U}{R} legendary Human Scientist Villain: ward 2, can't be blocked; whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 3/3 red Ape Villain token with haste.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Loki, the Deceiver ({1}{U}{B}{R} Villain: on attack, a tapped-and-attacking token copy of another Villain; Villain combat damage draws a card), EDHREC's 65% inclusion (discovery only).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Doom's connive at the beginning of combat guarantees a second draw on our turn, so Red Ghost makes a hasty 3/3 Ape Villain every turn; the Apes enter as Villains and trigger Prowler's connive, Baron Strucker's once-per-turn connive and Doom Reigns Supreme's drain (and those connives trigger Iron Monger). Red Ghost itself is an unblockable Villain target for Doom's connive and menace, protected by ward 2.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Ward is only a tax; the Ape is created on opponents' turns too only if we draw two there. Loki's attack copies, by contrast, enter after the beginning of combat has passed and never get Doom's connive (Pass C note), which is the main reason Loki underperforms here.
material_candidates.reason: A Villain engine keyed to the connive Doom already provides; it replaces a Villain whose copy text misses the commander's trigger window.

material_candidates.role: Land — Island Mountain, enters tapped; {T}: {U} or {R}; cycling {2}.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Shipwreck Marsh (UB slow-land, untapped from turn 3 with two other lands).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cycling is a land-discard event (Doom 2 to each opponent, Badgersaur/Nemesis Treasure, Bone Miser BB) without needing Tectonic Reformation; it is an Island Mountain, so Scalding Tarn, Polluted Delta and Bloodstained Mire fetch it, and Crucible of Worlds replays it to cycle again. material_candidates.source: EDHREC Doom general 6777/11386, upgraded 533/947, optimized 84/216; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {2} Equipment: equipped creature has hexproof and haste; equip {1}.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Fellwar Stone ({2} rock: any colour an opponent's land could produce), one of seven mana rocks (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Fellwar, three Talismans, The Soul Stone).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Doom is the engine (every land discard drains the table); hexproof (702.11b) stops only opponents' targeting, so Doom's own beginning-of-combat ability can still target Doom himself; haste lets a fresh Villain attack under menace the turn Doom connives it.

material_candidates.reason: Protection for the single engine the list cannot replace; the cut is the most redundant rock.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Six one-for-one swaps that add Doom land-discard events with a second job (removal, fast mana, a land), a per-card payoff, a Villain engine and engine protection. Losses: Feed the Swarm's enchantment removal (Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Otawara remain), Change of Fortune's refill (Green Goblin, Revenant, wheels and Big Score remain), Loki's Villain copies and combat-damage draw, Shipwreck Marsh's untapped UB, Fellwar Stone and Talisman of Creativity (two rocks; Mox Diamond replaces one). Game Changers 6 -> 7 (Mox Diamond).

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Selected six-swap package: commander-first. Two more land-discard outlets that are themselves cards with a job (Lightning Axe's cost, Mox Diamond's replacement, Coastal Peak's cycling), a per-card payoff (Glint-Horn), a Villain engine fed by Doom's connive (Red Ghost) and protection that keeps Doom's self-target (Boots). Land count unchanged (38); red land sources 20 -> 21.
Staged five-swap keeping Talisman of Creativity (no Mox Diamond, 6 Game Changers). Retained alternative.
Staged six-swap with Withering Torment instead of Lightning Axe. Rejected: no commander trigger, 3 mana.
Staged six-swap with Magmakin Artillerist instead of Glint-Horn Buccaneer. Rejected by the bounded grid (Buccaneer >= Artillerist in all 20 cells).
Staged Pass C exact pairing: Glint-Horn over Green Goblin, Revenant, keeping Change of Fortune. Rejected: Revenant is a Villain and becomes the refill.
Staged seven-swap with Pass C's Ledger Shredder over Iron Monger. Rejected: not a Villain.
Staged seven-swap with Pass C's Putrid Imp over Demand Answers. Rejected: redundant outlet, loses card flow.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C paired Glint-Horn Buccaneer with Green Goblin, Revenant. The bounded grid supports Glint-Horn, but it takes Change of Fortune's slot so Revenant stays as the Villain refill; the exact Pass C pairing (inside the six, and as a single swap on the baseline) is staged as complete 100s and rejected. Putrid Imp over Demand Answers and Ledger Shredder over Iron Monger are staged seven-swap 100s.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Doom pays per land-discard event and needs to survive to do it, yet the baseline had no protection for him, spent a Villain slot on Loki (whose copies miss the commander's combat trigger), a 4-mana refill Doom triggers once, sorcery-speed life-costing removal, a redundant opponent-dependent rock, a pinging Talisman and a UB land in a deck short of red for RRR Seismic.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Six swaps, all commander-first: three cards whose costs or cycling are Doom events (Lightning Axe, Mox Diamond, Coastal Peak), a per-card payoff (Glint-Horn), a connive-fed Villain engine (Red Ghost) and hexproof protection (Boots). Bounded Pass C tests are in the mechanics test. Spellbook: still 1 included combo (finite).

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Commander first, then lines alphabetically, all 1x. Six substitutions against the canonical source. 38 lands; 100 physical cards verified by quantity (99 library + 1 commander).

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the five-swap floor, Mox Diamond over Talisman of Creativity was added as a sixth swap, and every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool. Twelve post-floor challenges were recorded and rejected on Doom-specific grounds; two larger seven-swap packages (Pass C's Ledger Shredder over Iron Monger; Pass C's Putrid Imp over Demand Answers) are staged as complete 100s.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: A second per-card pinger next to Glint-Horn adds damage but removes the only one-sided refill left after cutting Change of Fortune; Revenant is a flying deathtouch Villain (Doom's connive target, Strucker/Tombstone discount, Prowler and Doom Reigns triggers).
Shredder adds connives but is not a Villain; Iron Monger converts every connive (Doom's every turn) into counters on each Villain.
Imp is a redundant free outlet beside Psychic Frog; Demand Answers finds the land cards that are the real bottleneck and its cost is a Doom event.
Bazaar makes no mana in a 38-land deck with a 4-mana three-colour commander and RRR Seismic.
Living Laser costs 5 and its copies arrive after Doom's beginning-of-combat trigger; Kang drains on the second draw that Doom's connive supplies.
Lethal Scheme's convokers connive (Doom events) and it hits planeswalkers; Terminate has no commander tie.
Lighthouse's loot is a repeatable graveyard-independent outlet; Sandbar is a mono-blue tapped land.
Tombstone is a cheaper Villain with recursion and a Villain cost reduction.
Faith's {1} tax competes with the loop's {R}; Cool but Rude and Glint-Horn already pay per card.
Deluge is the only sweeper; spot removal is already adequate.
Ash Barrens cycles once for a basic; Geier Reach is a repeatable outlet.
Owner-removed opponent-discard class; Leader doubles the draw on every connive.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Pass C asked for Ledger Shredder: connives on any player's second spell, so more land-discard events on opponents' turns.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Not a Villain: Doom can't target it and the Villain payoffs (Iron Monger, Prowler, Strucker, Doom Reigns Supreme) don't see it; Iron Monger is the Villain payoff for the same connives.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Pass C asked for Putrid Imp: a free, instant-speed outlet that turns every land in hand into a separate Doom drain.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Redundant with Psychic Frog, Seismic Assault, Trade Routes, Tectonic Reformation and cycling lands; the limit is land cards in hand, which Demand Answers digs for.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at six; the five-swap floor was not used as a target. Each remaining weak-looking slot beats its best challenger on Doom-specific grounds: Villain status for the connive and Villain payoffs (Revenant, Iron Monger, Kang, Tombstone, Leader), outlets that are already in excess of land supply (Demand Answers digs instead), mana in a 38-land three-colour list (Training Center), on-plan convoke removal (Lethal Scheme), repeatable land-slot outlets (Desolate Lighthouse, Geier Reach), the only wipe (Toxic Deluge), and respect for the owner's removal of opponent-discard punishers (Kefka, Syphon Mind not re-added).
